basis.title: General depreciation rates (IR265), July 2021
basis.by: Inland Revenue (Te Tari Taake), New Zealand
basis.label: Meters (water)
basis.note: Printed page 43. Water meters in a building fit-out. BDFO Building fit-out (when in books separately from building cost). Printed DV 13%, SL 8.5%. Tax depreciation lives set by the Commissioner of Inland Revenue for New Zealand income tax, not engineering or asset-management lives; they are banded and often short (e.g. reticulation piping 25 years). The July 2021 edition was the newest PDF reachable; the online Depreciation Rate Finder may hold later determinations.

open_questions: Every source here is a published planning, design or accounting life. None is observed replacement data.
